newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo corn futures end mixed, CBOT corn lower.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo corn futures end mixed, CBOT corn lower.

text.p: Tokyo corn futures closed mixed on Monday, as some months recovered by late afternoon from earlier losses, traders said.
Prices ranged from 170 yen lower to 80 yen higher. The benchmark September was up 30 yen at 17,390 yen per tonne. Daily volume was 63,102 lots.
A weaker Chicago corn market on Friday discouraged local investors and the bearish sentiment emerged during the morning session, the traders said.
"Technical buying from individual investors supported some later months," a brokerage house trader said.
The spot September contract on the CBOT Project A trading system was being traded at $3.58-1/2 per bushel at 0900 GMT, against $3.62-1/2 at Friday's close.
The spot September of the CBOT soybean futures on the overnight trading system was at $8.13-1/4 at 0900 GMT, against $8.24-1/4 from Friday's close.
